# Mogul Maker Academy

A business ownership education and implementation institution. Mogul Maker Academy (MMA) helps aspiring entrepreneurs, established business owners, and future acquirers develop the knowledge, judgment, operational capabilities, and practical systems required to build and manage valuable businesses.

Teaching philosophy: MAKE · MANAGE · MULTIPLY — create economic value, build operating discipline through Teams, Systems, and Capital, and develop lasting ownership and enterprise value. Supporting principle: Money Follows Management.

Founder: Antonio Cook, known as Mr. Mogul Maker — an independently positioned founder authority (media, speaking, thought leadership). MMA features and appropriately licenses founder content.

## Key pages
- / — Institution introduction: hero, ownership-journey pathways, 3M Framework preview, MMA experience, mission and founder introduction
- /start — Ownership journey routing: START (aspiring entrepreneur), OWN (income-to-ownership), GROW (established operator), ACQUIRE (strategic owner/acquirer)
- /framework — Interactive explanation of MAKE, MANAGE, MULTIPLY; Teams, Systems, Capital; Money Follows Management
- /academy — Membership education: Standard (foundation), Premium (path to ownership), VIP (owner-level strategy); details via the verified Skool community
- /workshops — Workshops and educational events; verified schedules and registration only
- /resources — Free business education organized by MAKE, MANAGE, MULTIPLY and business problem
- /about — Mission, educational philosophy, founder relationship, delivery principles, contact
- /implementation — Separately contracted professional implementation services (qualification-based; no public pricing)
- /contact — Enquiries and guidance
- /privacy, /terms, /accessibility — Policies
